question: Which of the following is a salt-water lake?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pangong Tso**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pangong Tso is a salt-water lake**__.

 
 
• Pangong Lake, situated at a height of almost 4,350m, is the **world’s highest saltwater lake**.
 
• Its water, which seems to be dyed in blue, stands in stark contrast to the arid mountains surrounding it.
 
• E
